text:
nora: Heads-up: deploybot auto-pinned runtime:5.2 -> 5.1 on eu-north at 23:40 UTC due to error spike on longseq. Seeing a mix of OOMs and cold-kernel falls.

deploybot: ALERT pinned runtime:5.2 -> 5.1 on pool:hosted-eu-north at 2026-03-22T23:40:12Z (trigger: host OOMs > 2 across 90s). evict log: /deploys/607890/ooms

ben: I pulled traces: new kernel allocator in runtime:5.2 holds a larger working set for kv cache when sequences > 48k. Only shows up with longseq+batching.

lucy: Wasnt that allocator change gated by a canary? Thought we had a phased rollout.

ben: Canary ran but with different traffic mix. Looks like canary didn't include longseq-heavy synthetic.

nora: Options: regional rollback runtime -> 5.1, or temporarily disable continuous-batching for longseq routes in eu-north. Which is lower risk for night window?

lucy: Disabling batching for longseq is lower blast radius and preserves kernels for variants that require 5.2. But will increase token-cost.

ops-bot: NOTE: change window 23:30-00:30 recorded. Auto-unpin disabled while remediation in-progress.

nora: Plan: 1) disable continuous-batching for longseq routes in eu-north now, 2) schedule targeted runtime rollback to 5.1 at 00:15 UTC if memory not stable, 3) add release note and runbook entry. Agree?

ben: Agree. Pushing flag: batching.longseq.enabled=false -> eu-north.

deploybot: INFO feature-flag applied: batching.longseq.enabled=false on pool:hosted-eu-north at 2026-03-22T23:47:03Z

lucy: Telemetry: mem usage dropping, OOMs stopped. p95 latency up ~30ms but acceptable. Running 25m stress now.

nora: If stress passes, we'll avoid rollback. If not, execute rollback at 00:15. I'll draft internal release-note: "Mitigated longseq OOMs in eu-north by disabling continuous-batching; follow-up: adjust allocator heuristics in runtime 5.2 and expand longseq canary tests."

release-bot: Release note (internal) queued: incident-607890. No customer-facing note needed.

ben: Adding runbook item: "When allocator changes land, include longseq synthetic in canary profile and cap batch concurrency heuristics."

lucy: Stress run complete 25m  mem stable, no new OOMs. Rolling back flag will be kept until allocator patch lands.

nora: Good work. Action items: ben to PR allocator fix, lucy to expand canary profiles, ops to schedule controlled unpin after patch verified. Closing thread for night shift.
